tools.name: list_accessible_customers
tools.description: Lists the Google Ads customer IDs the signed-in Google user can access directly. Call this first when you do not know which customerId to use for other tools. Client accounts reached through a manager (MCC) account are not listed here; query `customer_client` with the search tool on the manager account to find them.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the non-removed campaigns of one account with status, channel, daily budget and performance (impressions, clicks, cost, conversions) over a date range, most expensive first. Money is in account currency units. Use it for an overview and to get campaign IDs; use the search tool for anything more specific.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

tools.name: get_campaign_snapshot
tools.description: Reads one campaign completely in a single call: settings (bidding, networks, dates, location targeting mode), budget, location/language/device/ad schedule criteria, every non-removed ad group with its keywords, negatives and responsive search ads (with pins), campaign negatives, attached shared negative keyword lists with their keywords, and sitelinks, callouts and structured snippets linked to the campaign or its ad groups. Use it to copy or template a campaign, to review its structure, or to compare it with a planned version. Removed entities and account-level assets are left out; money is in account currency units.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns.

tools.name: get_resource_metadata
tools.description: Lists the fields of one GAQL resource (e.g. campaign, ad_group) that can be selected, filtered and sorted, plus the related resources, segments and metrics that can be selected with it. Call it before the search tool instead of guessing field names. The result rarely changes: reuse it.

resource.description: GAQL resource name, e.g. campaign, ad_group_criterion.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Fetches data from one Google Ads account with a structured GAQL query (read-only).
Builds SELECT <fields> FROM <resource> [WHERE <conditions joined by AND>] [ORDER BY <orderings>] [LIMIT <limit>].
Returns one object per row keyed by the requested field names. Values are as the REST API sends them:
int64 values (IDs, metrics, *_micros) as strings, money in micros (divide by 1,000,000), enums as names,
and null where the API omitted the value (for metrics that means 0).

Fields: do not guess them. Call get_resource_metadata for the resource first; always use full names
('campaign.id', not 'id'). No wildcards.
Dates: use 'YYYY-MM-DD' literals with an explicit start and end, e.g.
"segments.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'". Never use date-range literals such as LAST_30_DAYS.
change_event: requires a limit of at most 10000 and a finite date range on change_event.change_date_time.
Conversions: upload problems show up in offline_conversion_upload_conversion_action_summary.
Grammar: https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/query/grammar

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

resource.description: The resource after FROM, e.g. campaign, ad_group, keyword_view, search_term_view.

conditions.description: WHERE conditions combined with AND, e.g. ["campaign.status = 'ENABLED'", "metrics.clicks > 10"]. Quote string values with single quotes.

tools.name: suggest_geo_targets
tools.description: Finds geo target constants (countries, regions, cities, postal codes, ...) by name. Partial names work ("Mün" suggests Munich), so it suits search-as-you-type. Use it to turn a place name into the location ID that generate_keyword_ideas (locationIds) and location targeting need. Returns each match's ID, names, country, type and approximate reach. Not tied to an account.

items.description: A location name or the start of one.

names.description: Location names to look up, e.g. ["Munich"]. Suggestions for all names are merged.

locale.description: Language for the returned names, e.g. en, de. Default en.

countryCode.description: Only suggest locations in this country (ISO-3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. DE).

tools.name: generate_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Keyword Planner: generates keyword ideas with average monthly searches, searches per month, competition and top-of-page bid ranges, from seed keywords, a page URL, or both; with wholeSite, from every page of pageUrl's site instead of that one page. Use it to research new keywords or estimate demand before adding keywords. Searches per month cover the last 12 months unless fromMonth/toMonth set a range; ask for 13 or more months (e.g. 2025-08 to 2026-09) to compare a month with the same month a year earlier. Limits per request: 20 seed keywords and 10 locations; split larger requests. Find location IDs with suggest_geo_targets and language IDs with the search tool on language_constant. Bids are in account currency units.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

keywords.description: Seed keywords, e.g. ["car lease dubai"]. Up to 20.

pageUrl.description: A page to extract ideas from, or with wholeSite, any URL on the site.

wholeSite.description: Use the whole site of pageUrl (its host, path dropped) instead of just that page. Google's site seed takes no seed keywords, so leave keywords empty.

locationIds.description: Geo target constant IDs, up to 10, e.g. 2784 for the United Arab Emirates, 2840 for the United States. Find others with suggest_geo_targets. Omit for all locations.

languageId.description: Language constant ID, e.g. 1000 English, 1019 Arabic, 1031 Russian.

fromMonth.description: First month of searches per month, YYYY-MM. Set together with toMonth; default: 12 months ending with the last complete month.

toMonth.description: Last month of searches per month (inclusive), YYYY-MM.

network.description: Which network the search volumes are for.

tools.name: create_campaign_budget
tools.description: Creates a daily campaign budget on its own, e.g. a shared budget several campaigns will draw from. create_search_campaign can create a campaign with its own budget in one step, so this is only needed for shared budgets or to reuse one budget ID. A non-shared budget can belong to one campaign only. Budget names must be unique in the account. Nothing spends until a campaign using it is enabled.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

name.description: Budget name, unique among the account budgets.

dailyBudget.description: Average daily amount. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

explicitlyShared.description: true: a shared budget several campaigns can use. false: for exactly one campaign. No default on purpose: a shared budget splits spend across campaigns.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: create_search_campaign
tools.description: Creates a Search campaign with its budget, bidding, networks, dates and location and language targeting in one atomic request (all or nothing), PAUSED by default. It serves on Google Search only unless search partners or the Display Network are switched on. Give either dailyBudget (a new budget for this campaign) or budgetId (an existing one, e.g. shared). Then add ad groups (create_ad_group), keywords and ads, and enable it with enable_campaign once the user approves. Omitting locationIds targets every country; omitting languageIds targets all languages; the result warns about both. Find location IDs with suggest_geo_targets and language IDs with the search tool on language_constant. Run with validateOnly first to check everything without creating anything.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

name.description: Campaign name, unique in the account.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget for a new budget owned by this campaign. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

budgetId.description: Existing campaign budget ID to use instead of dailyBudget.

bidding.description: MAXIMIZE_CLICKS: most clicks for the budget, a safe start without conversion data. MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS: needs conversion tracking that records conversions. MANUAL_CPC: you set max CPC bids on ad groups or keywords.

maxCpcBidCeiling.description: Optional max CPC limit for MAXIMIZE_CLICKS. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

targetCpa.description: Optional target cost per conversion for MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

containsEuPoliticalAdvertising.description: The advertiser's declaration, required by Google: true if the campaign has political advertising aimed at the European Union. Ask the user; there is no default.

includeSearchPartners.description: Also serve on Google search partner sites. Default false.

includeDisplayNetwork.description: Also show ads on the Display Network. Default false; rarely wanted for Search.

status.description: PAUSED by default; enable once it has ad groups, keywords and ads.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the account time zone. Default: today.

endDate.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: runs until paused.

locationIds.description: Geo target constant IDs to target, e.g. 2784 (UAE). Up to 1000.

excludedLocationIds.description: Geo target constant IDs to exclude.

locationTargeting.description: PRESENCE (default): people in or regularly in the locations. PRESENCE_OR_INTEREST: also people elsewhere who search about them.

languageIds.description: Language constant IDs, e.g. 1000 English, 1019 Arabic.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Renames a campaign and/or switches its bidding strategy. Only the given fields change. Switching bidding resets automated learning, so performance can dip for a while. For status use pause_campaign / enable_campaign; for the budget use update_campaign_budget.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns or the search tool.

name.description: New campaign name, unique in the account.

bidding.description: MAXIMIZE_CLICKS: most clicks for the budget, a safe start without conversion data. MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS: needs conversion tracking that records conversions. MANUAL_CPC: you set max CPC bids on ad groups or keywords.

maxCpcBidCeiling.description: Optional max CPC limit for MAXIMIZE_CLICKS. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

targetCpa.description: Optional target cost per conversion for MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Pauses a campaign (status PAUSED): it stops serving and spending immediately. Reversible with enable_campaign.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns or the search tool.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: enable_campaign
tools.description: Enables a campaign (status ENABLED): it starts serving and spending as soon as Google approves its ads. Reversible with pause_campaign.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns or the search tool.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: update_campaign_budget
tools.description: Sets the daily amount of a campaign's budget. A shared budget (used by several campaigns) changes for all of them, so it is refused unless allowSharedBudget is true; the result lists how many campaigns use it.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns or the search tool.

dailyBudget.description: New daily budget. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

allowSharedBudget.description: Set true only when the user agreed to change a budget shared by several campaigns.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: create_ad_group
tools.description: Creates an ad group in an existing campaign, PAUSED by default so a half-built ad group cannot spend. Typical flow: create it, add keywords (add_keywords_to_ad_group) and an ad (create_responsive_search_ad), then enable it with update_ad_group_status. A dry run returns no ID, so to dry-run the next steps create the ad group for real (it cannot spend while paused) and dry-run against the returned ID.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign that will contain the ad group. Its channel must match the type.

name.description: Ad group name, unique within the campaign, at most 255 characters.

status.description: PAUSED by default; enable once the ad group has keywords and ads.

cpcBid.description: Optional default max CPC bid; omit to use the campaign bidding strategy (needed for manual CPC). In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: update_ad_group
tools.description: Renames an ad group and/or changes its default max CPC bid. Only the given fields change. The bid matters for MANUAL_CPC campaigns (keywords without their own bid use it); automated bidding ignores it. For status use update_ad_group_status.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

name.description: New ad group name, unique within the campaign.

cpcBid.description: New default max CPC bid. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: update_ad_group_status
tools.description: Sets an ad group to ENABLED, PAUSED or REMOVED. REMOVED is permanent (it cannot be re-enabled), so prefer PAUSED unless the user explicitly asked to delete it. An ENABLED ad group still does not serve while its campaign is paused.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

status.description: No default on purpose: each value affects spend differently.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: add_keywords_to_ad_group
tools.description: Adds positive keywords to an ad group, all with the same match type (call once per match type). The request is atomic: one invalid or duplicate keyword fails all of them, so use skipExisting for top-up runs. Pass bare text: "car lease dubai", not [car lease dubai] or "car lease dubai" in quotes.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID, digits only. Get it with the search tool on ad_group.

keywords.description: Bare keyword texts; each at most 80 characters and 10 words, at most 500 per call.

matchType.description: Match type for every keyword in this call. No default on purpose: it changes what the ad group buys.

cpcBid.description: Optional max CPC bid per keyword; omit to inherit the ad group bid. In account currency units (e.g. 1.25), not micros.

skipExisting.description: Skip keywords already in the ad group with the same text (any case) and match type instead of failing.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: update_keyword_status
tools.description: Pauses or enables positive keywords of one ad group by criterion ID, atomically (all or none). Paused keywords keep their history and can be enabled again; to delete one use remove_keyword_from_ad_group. Get criterion IDs with the search tool on ad_group_criterion.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID, digits only. Get it with the search tool on ad_group.

items.description: Criterion ID: the part after "~" in customers/1/adGroupCriteria/111~222.

criterionIds.description: Keyword criterion IDs, at most 500 per call.

status.description: No default on purpose: enabling starts spend once the ad group and campaign are enabled.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: remove_keyword_from_ad_group
tools.description: Removes one positive keyword from an ad group, selected by criterionId or by exact text plus match type. It is looked up first and must be a positive, non-removed keyword of that ad group (negatives are never touched). Removal is permanent: the keyword can only be re-added as a new criterion without its history.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID, digits only. Get it with the search tool on ad_group.

criterionId.description: Criterion ID: the part after "~" in customers/1/adGroupCriteria/111~222. Use either this or keyword.

keyword.description: Exact bare keyword text. Requires matchType.

matchType.description: Required with keyword. No default: the same text often exists in several match types.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: add_negative_keyword_to_ad_group
tools.description: Adds a negative keyword to one ad group so its ads stop showing for matching searches. Pass bare text (no brackets, quotes or leading minus). For a whole campaign use add_negative_keyword_to_campaign.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID, digits only. Get it with the search tool on ad_group.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.description: Adds a negative keyword to a campaign so none of its ads show for matching searches. Pass bare text (no brackets, quotes or leading minus).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns or the search tool.

tools.name: remove_negative_keyword_from_campaign
tools.description: Removes a campaign-level negative keyword matched by exact text and match type, so the campaign can show for those searches again.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, digits only. Get it from list_campaigns or the search tool.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: list_negative_keyword_lists
tools.description: Lists the shared negative keyword lists of an account with their size and how many campaigns use them, optionally with their keywords. Use it before creating a list (to reuse one) and to get list IDs.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

includeKeywords.description: Also return every keyword of every list.

tools.name: create_negative_keyword_list
tools.description: Creates a shared negative keyword list, optionally with keywords and attached to campaigns, in one atomic request. A shared list keeps the same negatives in sync across campaigns; for a one-off negative use add_negative_keyword_to_campaign. List names must be unique in the account.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

name.description: List name, unique among the account shared sets.

keywords.description: Negative keywords, e.g. [{ "text": "free", "matchType": "BROAD" }]. Match type defaults to EXACT. At most 1000 per call.

campaignIds.description: Campaigns to attach the list to right away.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: add_keywords_to_negative_keyword_list
tools.description: Adds negative keywords to a shared list, which applies them to every campaign using it. Keywords already in the list (same text, any case, and match type) are skipped instead of failing the request.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

listId.description: Negative keyword list (shared set) ID. Get it from list_negative_keyword_lists.

keywords.description: Negative keywords, e.g. [{ "text": "free", "matchType": "BROAD" }]. Match type defaults to EXACT. At most 1000 per call.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: remove_keywords_from_negative_keyword_list
tools.description: Removes negative keywords (matched by text, any case, and match type) from a shared list, so every campaign using the list can show for those searches again. All must exist in the list, or nothing is removed and the error names the missing ones. Removal is permanent.

listId.description: Negative keyword list (shared set) ID. Get it from list_negative_keyword_lists.

keywords.description: Negative keywords, e.g. [{ "text": "free", "matchType": "BROAD" }]. Match type defaults to EXACT. At most 1000 per call.

tools.name: attach_negative_keyword_list
tools.description: Applies a shared negative keyword list to campaigns. Campaigns that already use it are skipped. Reverse with detach_negative_keyword_list.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

listId.description: Negative keyword list (shared set) ID. Get it from list_negative_keyword_lists.

tools.name: detach_negative_keyword_list
tools.description: Stops campaigns from using a shared negative keyword list. The list and its keywords stay; only the link is removed. Every campaign must currently use the list, or nothing is detached.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

listId.description: Negative keyword list (shared set) ID. Get it from list_negative_keyword_lists.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: list_ads_in_ad_group
tools.description: Lists the ads of an ad group with status, Ad Strength and full responsive search ad copy (headlines, descriptions, pins, URLs, paths). Use it before writing a replacement ad and to get the adId for update_ad_status. Non-RSA ads come back with empty copy.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

tools.name: create_responsive_search_ad
tools.description: Creates a Responsive Search Ad in an existing search ad group, PAUSED by default (an enabled ad group would start spending on it at once; enable it with update_ad_status after review). Ad text and URLs cannot be edited after creation: to change copy, create a new ad and pause or remove the old one. Call list_ads_in_ad_group first to avoid repeating existing copy. Aim for 8-15 distinct headlines and 4 descriptions that each read well next to any other. Pinning is optional and discouraged; the result lists warnings about risky pins.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, 10 digits, dashes optional (e.g. 123-456-7890).

headlines.description: 3-15 headlines, each at most 30 characters, unique.

descriptions.description: 2-4 descriptions, each at most 90 characters, unique.

finalUrls.description: Landing page URLs; usually one, e.g. ["https://example.com/offer"].

headlinePins.description: Optional, exactly one entry per headline in the same order: null (unpinned) or HEADLINE_1..3 ("1".."3" accepted). Omit to leave all unpinned (recommended).

descriptionPins.description: Optional, one entry per description: null or DESCRIPTION_1..2.

path1.description: Display path after the domain, e.g. "car-leasing" → example.com/car-leasing.

path2.description: Second display path segment; requires path1.

validateOnly.description: Dry run: Google validates the request without executing it. Use it to check a change before making it.

tools.name: update_ad_status
tools.description: Sets an ad to ENABLED, PAUSED or REMOVED: the only change possible on an existing ad, and how an old ad is retired after its replacement was created. REMOVED is permanent and its copy cannot be recovered, so prefer PAUSED unless the user asked to delete it. Get IDs from list_ads_in_ad_group.

tools.name: list_callouts

tools.name: create_callouts

Callout text cannot be edited later; to change it, create a new callout, attach it and remove the old link. Check list_callouts first to reuse existing ones.

instructions:
Google Ads account tools over the REST API.
Start with list_accessible_customers (or list_campaigns when you know the customer ID).
Before the search tool, look fields up with get_resource_metadata instead of guessing them.
Mutating tools support validateOnly for a dry run; new campaigns' ad groups and ads start PAUSED.
Prefer pausing over removing: removals are permanent.
